statement: The singular-cubic discriminant in the full projective coefficient space is irreducible of degree 32.

answer.qualification: The degree-32 singular-cubic discriminant is the excluded locus for the 27-line cover over smooth cubic coefficient space; the cover is finite étale on its complement.

scope: Projective lines on smooth cubic surfaces in P3. Generic complex enumeration, real parameter chambers, and probability distributions on real coefficients are distinguished in individual associations.
